meta.title: 大鼻子肉垂脸姐妹 快来学雨琦的变时尚思路！
meta.title_en: Sisters with Big Noses & Droopy Faces: Learn Yuqi's Style Tricks!

scenes.title_en: Facial Features: A Short Heart-Shaped Face
scenes.context: 以韩国练习生视角分析雨琦的变美思路，先看面部特征。
sentences: 今天我从一个有韩国练习生的视角，好好给大家扒一扒雨琦到底做对了什么。
Today, from the perspective of a former Korean trainee, let's break down what Yuqi did right.
Korean trainee（韩国练习生）
雨琦其实是很典型的短心形脸。
Yuqi has a very typical short heart-shaped face.
heart-shaped face（心形脸）
两个眉间距很远，雨琦的眉头和眼头基本处于同一位置。
Her eyebrows are set far apart—her brow heads and eye heads sit at nearly the same position.
brow heads（眉头）
paraphrase: 先看面部特征再谈变美思路
短心形脸+眉间距远+眉头眼头同位置
scenes.speak: Today, from the perspective of a former Korean trainee, let's break down what Yuqi did right. First, look at her facial features. Yuqi has a very typical short heart-shaped face. Her eyebrows are set far apart—her brow heads and eye heads sit at nearly the same position.

scenes.title_cn: 两大问题：鼻子抢戏+脸垂疲惫
scenes.title_en: Two Problems: Nose Stealing the Show & Droopy Fatigue
scenes.context: 娇俏眉眼配中性鼻子风格失衡，肉肉脸容易显疲惫。
sentences: 像雨琦这种娇俏的眉眼，碰上偏粗偏中性的鼻子，如果妆容上没有把这两个风格平衡好，鼻子就会特别的抢戏。
Yuqi's cute eyes and brows meet a thicker, more neutral nose—if the makeup doesn't balance these two styles, the nose steals the show.
steal the show（抢戏）
她还有一个问题就是脸上本身肉肉比较饱满，脸一旦容易有点垂就会显得非常的疲惫。
She also has plump, fleshy cheeks—when the face tends to droop, it looks very tired.
droop（下垂）
最近这些特别出圈的一些造型，最大的变化不只是眼妆和发型，而是整张脸看起来更加紧致了。
Her recent standout looks changed more than just eye makeup and hair—the whole face looks firmer and tighter.
firmer（更紧致）
paraphrase: 娇俏眉眼+中性鼻风格失衡→鼻子抢戏
scenes.speak: Yuqi's cute eyes and brows meet a thicker, more neutral nose—if the makeup doesn't balance these two styles, the nose steals the show. She also has plump, fleshy cheeks—when the face tends to droop, it looks very tired. Her recent standout looks changed more than just eye makeup and hair—the whole face looks firmer and tighter.

scenes.context: 皮肤不贴合又肉肉就会显垂显疲惫，博主探店寻求解决方案。
sentences: 只要是皮肤不贴合又肉肉的情况，就会出现一点点显垂、显疲惫的这种状态。
Whenever the skin doesn't sit tight on plump flesh, a bit of droop and tiredness shows up.
sit tight（贴合）
我的理念是有问题就去专门的地方找专门的办法。
My philosophy: when there's a problem, go to the right place for the right solution.
the right place（专门的地方）
主要就是针对我的垂和松的问题，给我设计了一个比较适合我的方案。
They designed a plan tailored to my issues of sagging and looseness.
sagging and looseness（垂和松）
paraphrase: 皮肤不贴合+肉肉→显垂显疲惫
检测+王姐设计垂松方案+验证
scenes.speak: Whenever the skin doesn't sit tight on plump flesh, a bit of droop and tiredness shows up. My philosophy is simple: when there's a problem, go to the right place for the right solution. At the clinic, they tested my skin and designed a plan tailored to my issues of sagging and looseness, and verified the results.

scenes.title_en: Key to Beauty: Firmness & Nose Contour
scenes.context: 除了面部紧致，还有容易被忽略的鼻影技巧。
sentences: 她变好看的关键除了面部状态更加紧致以外，还有一个特别容易大家忽略的细节。
The key to her new look isn't just a firmer face—there's an easily missed detail.
easily missed（容易忽略）
雨琦的鼻梁本身就比较有存在感，所以她现在的妆容会有意识的把鼻影加重一点。
Yuqi's nose bridge is naturally prominent, so her makeup intentionally deepens the nose contour.
nose contour（鼻影）
这样一来，原本比较中性的鼻子会跟她甜甜的眉眼就平衡住了。
This way, the neutral nose is balanced against her sweet eyes and brows.
balanced（平衡）
paraphrase: 鼻梁有存在感→加重鼻影
scenes.speak: The key to her new look isn't just a firmer face—there's an easily missed detail. Yuqi's nose bridge is naturally prominent, so her makeup intentionally deepens the nose contour. This way, the neutral nose is balanced against her sweet eyes and brows.

scenes.title_cn: 眉眼重心法：视觉重心上移
scenes.context: 眉间距宽别用刘海遮，而要用眼妆把视觉重心往上移。
sentences: 她最近的这个眼妆也明显的有存在感了，就是把大家的视觉重点往眉眼上去带。
Her eye makeup now clearly has presence—it pulls everyone's visual focus toward the eyes and brows.
visual focus（视觉重点）
如果再用厚重的大面积的刘海把额头全部遮住，视觉上面反而会更集中到鼻子上，会更容易适得其反。
If she covers her forehead with a heavy, full fringe, attention actually concentrates on the nose instead—it backfires.
backfires（适得其反）
把重心放在眉眼上，通过更有存在感的眼妆把视觉重心往上移，这样五官的比例反而会更加的和谐和协调。
By focusing on the eyes and brows, she lifts the visual center upward, making her facial proportions look more harmonious.
facial proportions（五官比例）
paraphrase: 眼妆有存在感→视觉重点往眉眼带
遮额头→视觉集中鼻子→适得其反
眼妆带视觉重心上移→比例更和谐
scenes.speak: Her eye makeup now clearly has presence—it pulls everyone's visual focus toward the eyes and brows. Covering the forehead with a heavy fringe backfires and concentrates attention on the nose. Instead, she lifts the visual center upward with bold eye makeup, making her facial proportions look more harmonious.

practice: 请将中文句子翻译成英文：如果妆容上没有把这两个风格平衡好，鼻子就会特别的抢戏。
If the makeup doesn't balance these two styles, the nose steals the show.
请将英文翻译成中文：By focusing on the eyes and brows, she lifts the visual center upward, making her facial proportions look more harmonious.
把重心放在眉眼上，通过更有存在感的眼妆把视觉重心往上移，这样五官的比例反而会更加的和谐和协调。
pitfalls: Covering wide-set brows with a heavy fringe
Focus makeup on the eyes and brows instead
A full fringe makes attention concentrate on the prominent nose and backfires
Trying to hide a prominent nose
Deepen the nose contour to balance the neutral nose
A bold nose contour pairs the nose with the sweet eyes and brows
Relying on makeup alone to fix a droopy face
Tight skin sits better, then makeup can enhance
Copying others' tricks without reading your own features
Analyze your own facial features first
Methods must fit your specific face
